payload:
You are the semantic Windows UI Automation implementation agent for Heaven Local Bridge. Execute the work; do not merely review or propose.

Repository: fengie/mhw-mods. Canonical durable source is origin/main. The heaven-bridge branch is transport only. Machine is heaven. Do NOT use Remote Desktop Commander.

Goal: extend the bridge beyond coordinate-based GUI control with semantic Windows UI Automation/accessibility-tree actions. Work from a fresh short-lived worktree/branch based on current origin/main under the user's home directory, preserving unrelated concurrent changes.

Requirements:
- Inspect current heaven-bridge/worker.py, tests, docs, and scripts first.
- Add structured semantic actions suitable for Windows UIA, with safe bounded selectors and deterministic results. At minimum aim for: uia_tree / uia_find / uia_invoke / uia_focus / uia_set_value (names may be adjusted if architecture strongly favors better names). Support selectors by automation id, name, control type, class name, process/window scope, and bounded depth/result counts where available.
- Prefer a robust native/standard Windows approach or a small well-justified dependency. If adding a dependency, make installation/bootstrap reliable and document it.
- Fail closed on ambiguous matches unless an explicit first_match option is provided.
- Never expose passwords or sensitive textbox values in tree/find results; redact password controls and do not return secret content.
- Add capability advertisement, validation, focused tests (including non-Windows-safe unit coverage where possible), README/skill docs, and live non-destructive GUI smoke(s) on heaven.
- Preserve every existing v0.4.x capability and compatibility test.
- Run py_compile, heaven-bridge/test_worker.py, discovery under heaven-bridge/tests, and any new tests.
- When complete, sync with latest origin/main, resolve conflicts, rerun relevant gates, integrate your finished work into main, push origin/main, verify remote main contains the commit, then delete the finished temporary local/remote branch if safe. Do not merge relay queue/status/results history.
- Report concise evidence: final main SHA, changed files, test counts, live smoke evidence, any dependency/version changes, and any remaining gaps.
- If another agent lands overlapping changes, reconcile rather than overwriting them.
